As avid traveler service providers, we handle all formalities for travel permits, including flights, cruises, hotel bookings, and visas for Indian citizens. Our expertise lies in tourist and visitor visa applications worldwide, with a dedicated team ensuring positive outcomes by navigating visa documentation and liaising with higher authorities.

Proudly recognized as Chandigarh, Ropar, and New Nalagarh’s trusted tourist visa consultants, we have successfully processed thousands of visas. Whether you need guidance or assistance, feel free to reach out for our exceptional and affordable services.

Choosing the right career path is the most important decision in an individual’s life. Each one of us has gone through this difficult phase. However, with  Best Career Counseling Centres services providers in Chandigarh like Hashtag British Centre for Learning, selecting a career is no more a cumbersome task.

Studying overseas is a big decision monetarily and emotionally for parents as well for the students. Whether you are a fresh 10 + 2 pass out, a fresh graduate with/out work experience, or post-graduate, expert advisers at British Centre for Learning help students in working on their career options after analysis of academics, aptitude interest of the students, available finances, scholarships, specific location requirements, etc. At Hashtag, we make sure that all possible efforts are taken to guide students in selecting their study programs.
Some of the services we provide during Career Counseling Centres in Chandigarh may include:

At Hashtag, we comprehend and investigate the career requirement of the students. We provide professional support and assist students in organizing their opinions and ideas about career options and professional objectives.

Students looking for postgraduate and doctorate level studies from abroad should select the universities having worldwide recognition and that are offering excellent education. At Hashtag, we help students to take their final call on the selection of the right university.

At Hashtag, we assist students in filling up the admission form, getting financials ready, documentation process and in applying for visa. The counselors at Hashtag help students at every step to make them realize their dream of studying abroad successful.

Visa Processing and visa interview holds the key to a students’ successful departure to a foreign university. The visa team at Hashtag is always updated with the latest requirement, immigration policies and visa checklists. At Hashtag, we have a database of possible visa interview questions depending upon students’ profile.

At British Centre for Learning, we also provide assistance to the students on arranging the finances. We make students understand the entire breakup of the expenditure involved and suggest them various options available in making them realize their dream of education abroad.

Aiming to know the real reason behind your decision to for education abroad and understanding scope of your study area nationally and internationally and to know your academic background SOP (Statement of Purpose) is required from a students’ end. At Hashtag, we help students in preparing genuine and honest still appealing SOP.
